supersedes: scenario-level replay outcomes in v1; v1 fixtures remain historical evidence
decision_rationale: The v1 QFT program-fault positives have ideal TVD below the configured 0.05 behavioral effect gate; source localization alone does not establish a behavioral fault.
A non-significant count comparison is not promoted to an anomaly based on source syntax or a known injected condition.

A significant finite-sample comparison can occur on an identical-distribution control at alpha 0.05; it is recorded as an unattributed anomaly and does not become a program or hardware fault without its separate evidence.
The four-shot sampling-difference control is not significant under the count test and is classified NO_ANOMALY.
The per-seed replay rows are regression checks, not an estimate of population false-positive rate. Calibration and held-out statistical performance remain evaluated separately.
